title: Youth Global Forum 2027, Paris (Center for Global Dialogue and Leadership)
organization: Center for Global Dialogue and Leadership (CGDL), Toronto, Canada (self-described 'independent Canadian public policy institute')
overview: A four-day youth forum in Paris, 20-23 January 2027, promoted by aggregators as 'Fully Funded'. The organiser's own page offers 30 fully funded and 40 partially funded seats out of 250, charges a non-refundable USD 16.99 registration fee to apply for them, and sells the other 180 seats for USD 399 to USD 999.99. Listed as a warning, not a recommendation.
deadline_text: CGDL home page: 'Fully Funded Deadline 18 NOVember 2026'. YGF 2027 page: 'Deadline for funded applications 20 NOVember 2026'. The two official pages disagree; the earlier date is recorded.
funding_details: Fully Funded category (30 seats, competitive): round-trip international airfare support, twin-shared accommodation at a 4-star hotel, meals and coffee breaks, forum participation, workshops, institutional visits, conference materials, certificate, visa invitation letter
Partially Funded category (40 seats, competitive): the same, but airfare is 'Not Included'
Refund policy: 'Fully funded delegates will be reimbursed for travel expenses after the event' within 4 to 8 weeks of a completed reimbursement form, so airfare is paid upfront
Registration fee for the funded categories: USD 16.99, 'mandatory, non-refundable, and cannot be disputed under any circumstances'
Visa: 'Securing a visa is solely the delegate's responsibility'; the invitation letter alone is sold for USD 99 or USD 299.99 (two prices shown)
participation_fee: USD 16.99 non-refundable registration fee to apply for the funded seats. Guaranteed paid seats: Forum Admission USD 799.99 / 399.00 and Self-Funded USD 999.99 / 699.0 (the page shows two prices for each).
eligibility: 'Young leaders from all countries and academic backgrounds'; no prior experience needed
Funded seats: rubric-based selection on motivation and clarity of purpose, leadership potential and community engagement, relevance to the forum themes, and global awareness
other_requirements: Signing the terms and conditions declaration before checkout for the funded categories (refund policy page)
application_process: One form covers the Fully and Partially Funded categories; the 'Apply Now' button leads to a checkout that charges USD 16.99 (the form itself was not opened)
Funded applicants are chosen competitively; Forum Admission and Self-Funded seats are 'guaranteed' on payment

sources.label: CGDL: Youth Global Forum 2027 page (seats, categories, fees, age range, FAQ)
CGDL: refund policies (non-refundable funded-category fee; travel reimbursed after the event; visa is the delegate's responsibility)
CGDL home page (deadline 18 November 2026; list of previous events)

eligibility_reason: The stated criteria (age 16 to 46, any country, no experience needed) fit the recorded profile. Eligibility to apply is not a place: the 70 funded seats are chosen competitively, the applicant would pay a non-refundable fee first, and the selection rubric (motivation, leadership, relevance) cannot be checked against the profile.
potential_issues: A non-refundable USD 16.99 fee is charged before selection ('mandatory, non-refundable, and cannot be disputed under any circumstances')
Only 30 of 250 seats are fully funded and 40 partially funded (no airfare); the other 180 seats are sold for USD 399 to USD 999.99
Fully funded delegates are reimbursed for travel 'after the event' (4 to 8 weeks after a form), so the airfare must be paid first
The visa is 'solely the delegate's responsibility'; a visa invitation letter is a separate paid item outside the funded packages
The home page and the event page give different funded deadlines (18 and 20 November 2026)
The organiser runs a series of similar paid events (Berlin 2026, Madrid 2026, Istanbul 2025, Geneva 2025) and describes itself as a public policy institute; no independent confirmation was read
Aggregators call it 'Fully Funded'; the organiser's own wording is a competitive 'Fully Funded' category inside a paid-registration forum
benefits: Four days of workshops and policy masterclasses (as described by the organiser)
relevance_reason: Included as a warning about the paid-application 'fully funded' forum pattern. If selected, the trip would be to Paris, but the odds are low and the costs start before any decision.

visa.support: Invitation letter only; the delegate obtains the visa (refund policy page)

upfront_cost_risk: High: non-refundable application fee, then airfare paid upfront and reimbursed 4 to 8 weeks after the event
action: Do not pay the fee on the strength of the 'Fully Funded' label. Listed as a warning: 30 funded seats of 250, a non-refundable application fee, airfare reimbursed only after the event, and a visa you must obtain yourself.
notes: Found through an aggregator search on 2 November 2026 (several sites repeat '30 Fully Funded and 40 Partially Funded seats'); the organiser's own pages were then read. Not recommended.
